data.gender_notes: Qadeerat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who is powerful and capable. The name Qadeerat carries the meaning “Powerful, capable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qadeerat usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, capable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who has the ability to shape her own destiny
data.etymology: Qadeerat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, capable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qadeerat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: قدرات
in_arabic.meaning: القدرة و الإمكانيات اللامحدودة لله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و معناه القدرة و الإمكانيات اللامحدودة لله تعالى، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و الإرادة. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، منها قوله تعالى: 'و ما قدروا الله حق قدره'، و في سورة الأنعام: 'و هم لا يقدرون على شيء مما كسبوا'.

in_urdu.name: قدرات
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالی کی غیر محدود طاقت و اختیار
in_urdu.long_meaning: اردو میں اس نام کا مطلب ہے اللہ تعالی کی غیر محدود طاقت و اختیار، اور یہ نام قدرت و اختیار کے معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے، اور اس کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں بھی آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ انعام میں: 'و هم لا يقدرون على شيء مما كسبوا'۔

in_hindi.name: क़दीरात
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह की असीमित शक्ति और सामर्थ्य
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिन्दी में इस नाम का अर्थ है अल्लाह की असीमित शक्ति और सामर्थ्य। यह नाम शक्ति और अधिकार के अर्थ में प्रयोग होता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है, और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी आया है, जैसे कि सूरा अन्फाल में: 'और वे अपने किए हुए कामों की क्षतिपूर्ति करने में असमर्थ हैं'।

in_pashto.name: قدرات
in_pashto.meaning: د الله تعالی بې پایته ځواک او واک
in_pashto.long_meaning: په پښتو کې د دې نوم مطلب دے د الله تعالی بې پایته ځواک او واک. دا نوم د قدرت او واک په معنا کې کارول کېږي. دا نوم د افغانانو او پښتنو په مېنځ کې مشهور دے، او د اسلامي نومونو له جملې څخه دى.

in_english.name: Qadeerat
in_english.meaning: Limitless power and authority of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Qadeerat signifies the limitless power and authority of Allah. It originates from Arabic roots and is mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing the omnipotence of God. The term 'Qadeerat' embodies the concept of divine power and capability, making it a significant and revered name in Islamic culture.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Qadeerat is considered a powerful name that signifies strength, determination, and capability. It is believed to be an inspiring name for women, as it suggests that the person carrying it is capable of overcoming challenges and achieving great things.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Qadeerat is associated with the belief in Allah's power and capability. It is a reminder that Allah is the one who gives us the strength and ability to accomplish our goals and overcome our struggles. The name Qadeerat also signifies the idea that everything is in Allah's hands, and that He is the ultimate controller of all things. Therefore, bearing this name can serve as a constant reminder of Allah's power and the importance of putting trust and faith in Him.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Powerful, capable" symbolizes She who is powerful and capable. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Qadeerat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of powerful, capable.
